newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY Q1 1997 GDP RISES 1.2 PCT YR/YR VS 0.0 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY Q1 1997 GDP RISES 1.2 PCT YR/YR VS 0.0 PCT.

text.p: Hungary's gross domestic product (GDP) rose 1.2 percent in the first quarter of 1997 in year-on-year terms, compared with a stagnation in the same period of 1996, the central statistical office (KSH) said on Tuesday.
NOTE - The figures are preliminary, and are calculated on the basis of 1995 prices.

The KSH said it was the first time for years that household consumption rose. Household consumption got a boost from a rise of 10,000 in the number of the employed in the first quarter of the year, the statistical office said.
It added that a boom of investments continued and the a slowinc rate of increase in the firts quarter of 1997 than in the previous quarter was due to seasonality.

Imports rose quicker than exports but imports increased relatively slowly in 1996 while exports grew dynamically in the comparative period of last year and also in the second quarter of 1996, the KSH said.
A 24 percent rise in machinery imports contributed substantially to the increase in imports, it added.
